Application Data.NAME: Journey Planners LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Journey Planners LLC specializes in planning and coordinating travel experiences for individuals and groups. Our services include customized travel itineraries, hotel accommodations, transportation arrangements, and guided tours. We work closely with reputable travel vendors to ensure our clients receive high-quality service and support. Our agency also provides consultation for travel-related issues and offers information on travel advisories, regulations, and best practices. With three years of operational history, we prioritize client communication, risk management, and compliance with industry standards to deliver exceptional travel experiences.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2023, a client experienced a flight cancellation due to adverse weather conditions, resulting in unexpected costs for additional lodging and meals, amounting to $2,500. The claim was filed and is currently in progress, awaiting approval. On 09/10/2023, a booking error occurred where a client was mistakenly booked for the wrong hotel dates, prompting a reimbursement request of $2,500. This claim has been resolved in favor of the client with payment issued. Total losses to date: $5,000.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class C, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard services provided during peak travel seasons and emergency response planning for client travel disruptions.
